text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and her fellow students are
staying at a seaside
facility for the summer
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's it for today's training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The camp has only just begun, so better
safe than sorry. I should go
for a cooldown
walk.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you certainly make a tempting offer.
Very well then—I could
use the company.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The mind needs breaks too, after all.
There should be a seaside cafe
nearby, if
you're feeling as peckish as I am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We wrap up Symboli Rudolf's training and
head for lunch. Then, later
that evening...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good evening, Trainer. Working in
your free time? You're
certainly dedicated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was conducting a light patrol of the
camp. ...Perhaps I have too
much time on
my hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Although, I suppose it's a good thing that
there are no issues to
demand my
attention...
Aaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Wh-what was that scream?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's go! I pray nothing is wrong!
Aaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The screams are coming from more than
one direction! What in the
world is going
on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... That last scream came from somewhere around here...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand. I'm sure I heard
someone here just moments ago...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please... be safe, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whoa! P-president?! I'm so sorry—I
thought you were a
classmate!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
We're so, so, so sorry! A bunch of us were
goofing off, trying to scare
each other. I
don't even know where to start
apologizing...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You were scaring each other? ...So, no one
is hurt or in danger?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! What a relief! If nothing else, you certainly did a great job of spooking me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-um... President Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Ah, it's nothing. I'm just happy
you're making the most of
your time
together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for interrupting your game.
Please, carry on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is something the matter? You all
seem rather lost for words...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A scolding? But they've done nothing
wrong. This is their own free
time—why
shouldn't they use it as they see fit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're all students. There's more to our
lives than racing and training,
and the
times we spend together will serve as a
vital springboard for
the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, each day of our lives comes but
once. During a special event
like this
camp, who wouldn't want to make fun
memories to look back
on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even I... Haha. Yes, I would be lying if I
were to claim I didn't enjoy
these little
everyday moments.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Now, now. You know I can't impose
on them like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pay my trainer's words no mind, everyone.
We've a long camp ahead
of us, so you
should take this opportunity to recharge—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-um! President Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If it's all right with you... Would you, you
know, care to join us?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Only if it's no trouble, though!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trouble? Perish the thought. Hehe... I
would be delighted to join you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Alpha Team, report.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! Preparations are complete,
and everyone's in position!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Next, Bravo Team, make your
way to the staging area. Stay
alert for any
lurking dangers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once you locate an ideal spot, hide
yourselves. You know what to do
after
that, correct?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We jump out and give the others a
good scare!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Superb. Best of luck, and let's scare up
some good fun.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that really so surprising? I want this
spook-off to be a runaway
success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It would be a shame if we didn't put forth
our best effort for the
participants. A team
effort will maximize the scare factor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You know, you're right. I've never
had this much fun at a
training camp
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus begins an event that will go down in
history as the camp's most
thrilling
spook-off.
